key: KXNYCCOUNCIL14|Who will win the NYC City Council election in District 14?|If Fernando Cabrera wins the New York City Counil race for District 14 in 2025, then the market resolves to Yes.
reasoning: Fernando Cabrera did not win the NYC City Council election in District 14 in 2025. Incumbent Pierina Sanchez won both the June 24, 2025 Democratic primary with 66.4% of the vote and the November 4, 2025 general election with 99.2% of the vote. Cabrera finished second in the primary with 22.2% of votes. The market closes on 2025-11-07, after both elections were held and certified by the NYC Board of Elections. The resolution criteria explicitly states the market resolves YES only if Fernando Cabrera wins the race, which he did not.
